newsitem.title: USA: CACI International wins $4.3 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: CACI International wins $4.3 mln contract.

text.p: CACI International Inc said Thursday it was awarded a one-year, $4.3 million contract to make the U.S. Federal Deposit Insurance Corp year 2000 compliant.
CACI said it expects to begin work immediately.
The year 2000, or millennium, bug is a global programming problem by which many older computers and software programs will be unable to process two-digit dates correctly after December 31, 1999.
When the year 2000 changes over, these systems may misinterpret the "00" date field as "1900," and crash or lose data.

CACI said that included in the project is remediation of several different types of code across multiple programming languages and platforms, such as COBOL, CA-Ideal, Clipper, Assembler, FOCUS, Oracle SQL, Visual Basic, C, FoxPro, Paradox and other languages.
